'''Marite''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]. She was cast out of her clan on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] because of her force-sensitive abilities and lived in [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was outspoken and had an outgoing personality and championed the idea of bringing more people to Aurilia, to study the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She helped to do this through her role as the village's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to the outside world, although she was also a skilled healer. She had feelings for [[Noldan]], but did not want to act upon them until she knew Aurilia was safe, as it was under attack from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] and his [[Sith Shadows]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although featured in the Friday Feature, ''Village of Aurilia'', Marite was not implemented as an NPC in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
